verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents privacy controls, both per-request and account-wide, that restrict routing to providers with a given data policy and let users opt out of providers that may train on their data. A community comment also notes a global 'ZDR-only' toggle. These controls cover downstream provider logging and training, not opting out of OpenRouter's own telemetry or usage tracking; its usage analytics are presented as a feature. Missing for 10: documented opt-out of OpenRouter's own telemetry/usage tracking, first-party docs on its own prompt-logging retention controls, independent corroboration that the controls work as described.
